messages.subject: Lavaan Beginner: Pathway Labeling Question
parts:
Hi Everyone! 

I'm a beginner with lavaan and still working on buffing up my statistics knowledge. I'm working on building my model syntax, but I'm having a little difficulty conceptually with labeling the pathways for the following model (e.g. a1, a2, b1, b2, c', etc.) due to there being two mediators and a moderator involved. Is anyone able to assist but also explain why it would be labeled that way? 
Thank you kindly!

From a technical point of view, it doesn't matter at all. You can name the parameters "Jack" or John" as long as you know what is meant by it. This has no impact on the parameter estimates. If - for whatever reason - it is important for you to follow a certain norm for the syntax, then you can, for example, use the Jöreskog notation or Bentler Weeks or .....

HTH

Christian
